lines.en: label nikispring8:
scene sayanything1
: Please move back into my house and stop convincing my friends to use knife karate on me.
: Sir, I’m afraid I’m going to have to ask you to leave. And to take the floating terms of use with you. You are not supposed to be here.
: And yet I am. For the only place I truly belong is by the side of my childhood friend.
: Oooohhh...so that’s the guy who cheated on her. Wait, really? That’s who she’s been ranting about all day?
: Don’t scoff just yet. It takes a special sort of guy to Say Anything a girl. Plus, if this works out, maybe she’ll actually be able to finish the shoot.
: Niki Nakayama — I am sorry. Please accept this grand gesture and come back to me.
scene sayanything2
: Did I play the wrong song? This is not the reaction Noriko told me I’d get.
: I think that’s a pretty reasonable reaction, to be fair.
scene sayanything3
: There’s no way he’s legally allowed to use this song, right?
: You see, that’s what I thought too. But I reviewed the terms of use he floated in with and it looks like he is allowed to use it so long as its not for commercial purposes.
: Aren’t there limits to fair use, though? Like the amount of time you’re allowed to play a certain song for and how it needs to have some sort of...commentary or satire to it?
: Fair use doesn’t have anything to do with this case since Peter Gabriel Ltd. uploaded the song to a platform that users need to register and pay for.
: It’s effectively a highly limited single-use license that’s really only valid under very specific circumstances and this just happens to be one of them.
: Assuming, of course, that this isn’t real life and that we all live in a sort of Truman Show-esque scenario in which we’re all being constantly watched and broadcast without our knowledge.
: Which would be a much bigger legal issue than just using a forty-year old song anyway, so...
: Huh...so there’s just nothing we can do to stop him then?
scene sayanything4
: It doesn’t look like it, no. He could carry that boombox around for the rest of his life and we’d have no legal grounds to intervene.
: Which I may just wind up doing since I don’t know anything else that would be powerful enough to overtake the fact that I am a disgusting, unfaithful, adulterous piece of shit.
: Lloyd Dobler would never.
scene sayanything5
: Have you lost your fucking mind? You really think you can just walk in here and Say Anything me and that I’ll cave and move back into your shitty house? Get bent.
: Noriko told me you might say that. To which I’m supposed to say, “I love that you get cold when it’s 71 degrees out. I love that it takes you an hour and a half to order a sandwich. I love-”
scene sayanything6
: Knock it off with the 80’s rom-com references! I don’t care how deeply they resonate with my idealized perception of how couples are supposed to be! You fucked my sister!
: I did. And I am sorry. But being without you in addition to other recent events has made me realize more than anything that I need your help.
: So much so that I am apparently now willing to do ridiculously embarrassing things like storming into an active commercial shoot and blasting Peter Gabriel for everyone to see and hear.
scene sayanything7

: Which is what you wanted, right? You want everyone to know how sorry I am. How desperate I am. How intensely, pathetically lost and in love with you I am. And how it’s been that way since we were kids.
: Keep going. And turn that fucking song off.
: I can’t. I don’t know how many other chances I’ll get to use it and I’m really trying to milk the most out of the license that I possibly can.
: Akira, this is the dumbest fucking thing you have ever done.
: I agree completely. But you’ve got to admit, it’s unexpected. Right? Which probably earns me some points. Like, this scene would be great in a movie.
scene sayanything8
: Because it was already in one! And it’s going to take a lot more than cheap tugs at my heartstrings to win me back, you know!
: Then tell me what I can do. Please. Say anything and I’ll do it.
: And now you’re name-dropping the title!
: That one was an accident.
scene sayanything9
: Niki, I have lived in the palm of your hand for what is essentially my entire life. And yes, I’ve fallen out of it a few times and tried to survive on my own just to fail in the end.
: I want to be done with that, though. I want to be comfortable between your fingers regardless of the damage I will inevitably do to you because that is where I belong.
: So for once, I’m not running away. I’m running to you. To apologize for everything. To apologize for what we’ve been through and what we’ll go through, because all of it is my fault.

: And I ask you now to come back to me, knowing full-well that you are better off with someone else who isn’t going to make your life a living hell and that I am taking advantage of you by doing that.
: But I don’t care. That’s how selfish I am. I must have you by any means necessary because I can not escape the hole I’ve fallen into without your help.
: In your eyes, I am complete.
scene sayanything10
: That one was on purpose.
scene sayanything11
: Patrice! I’m taking the day off!
: But...Niki, you’re in the middle of a shoot. You have one line left.
: And the English version...
: I don’t care! I’m a celebrity and my mental health is important. Come on, Lloyd. You have some more groveling to do.
: Yes, ma’am. But I’m keeping the song on.
scene black
: Fine. But when you inevitably draw the attention of every fucking person we encounter, you must tell them you are my slave. Do you understand?
: Yes. I am entirely ready to be emasculated for the indefinite future. This is just one more example of how serious I am.
: Uhh...I...I guess we’re done? We’re still getting paid for today, right?
: Hah...I really hope so...
scene sky
I follow Niki out of the studio and hop into a taxi she charters, bound for...some sort of emotionally relevant location, I’m sure.
if amispring5 == True:
And while I can’t tell if the strategy I devised with Noriko following the events of a certain drugging in my house the other day is working, I’m trying to remain positive.
Which is a crazy thing to do after your daughter kidnaps a girl and tries to make you have sex with her, but it’s something I need to do if I want to have any hope of fixing this.
else:
And while I can’t tell if the strategy I devised with Noriko the other day is working, I’m trying to remain positive.
Which is a crazy thing to do when you have a daughter you don't feel safe sleeping in the same house with, but it’s something I need to do if I want to have any hope of getting to that point.
Because yes, history shows that having Niki around does not exactly make Ami more sane. But it makes her something.
And I think the answer to that is far more complicated than just “angry that Niki doesn’t support incest.” I’m sure intimidation is a part of it, though.
Because that’s how it is for Maya and, as much as I hate saying it, Ami isn’t all that different from her at the end of the day. They both fear Niki because they both know how important she is to me.
Does Niki know that, though?
Because, if not, I hope she will by the end of the day. Just like I hope that the end of the day is the start of something new.
Anyway, we’ve arrived at the emotionally relevant location. And I have some work to do, so...
Goodbye for now.
And wish me luck.
scene sayanything12
: Ugh...I can’t believe you fucking Say Anything’ed me at work. Where the fuck did you even get a boombox? Did Noriko help with that too?
: She did. But I sort of needed her help if I was ever going to appeal to you since we both know how colossally I have fucked up this time.
: Yes, it was an expertly executed one-two punch having her soften me up so you could storm in and deliver the killing blow. Oh, how happy I am to see how much chemistry you two have.
: Niki...I don’t know how many times I can apologize for doing what I did with her, but I am more than willing to stand here and find the answer if you want me to.
: No amount of apologizing is going to fix or even explain what you did, Akira. But we both know it doesn’t fucking matter anyway because I exist to be taken advantage of by you.
: Take advantage of me too, then. Please. Whatever it takes to win you back, I’ll do it.
scene sayanything13
: You can start by putting the boombox down.
scene sayanything14
: Do I really have to?
: You’re actually starting to like this song, aren’t you?
: I think, based on context, this is officially our song. Which is great since we were pretty overdue for one.
: Hah...fucking romantic comedies. Of all the moves for you to pull, it had to be that. Noriko knows her shit.
: I had no idea you even liked them that much.
: Yeah, because you’re a selfish piece of shit who’s never paid much attention to me while I’ve been fucking obsessed with you ever since we met.
scene sayanything15
: What took you so long?...Idiot.
: Stubbornness. Lack of direction. And more misunderstanding you in thinking that you’d be able to function on your own despite our clear co-dependence.
: I’m still alive, aren’t I?
: Yeah, but if it’s anything like the sort of “alive” I am, it probably doesn’t feel like you are. And you’re probably tired of waking up alone.
: Why am I like this? Do I have Stockholm Syndrome or something? How come you can keep doing terrible things to me just to somehow win me back in the end? I don’t consent to this.
: I’m sure I’d be the same way if you ever did anything terrible to me. You just won’t because you’re a good person and I’m not.
: You’re the actual worst person I’ve ever met. My life would be irrefutably better if we never crossed paths. If you never made me fall for you.
: How did I do that in the first place? Like, I still don’t understand. Even those people in the studio took one look at me and thought you were insane.
: I’ll let you know if I ever figure it out. For now, I’ll remain hopeless, confused, and furious at where I’ve ended up again despite how many times I told myself I wouldn’t this time.
: Come home, Niki.
: Your home was never mine. Ami made sure of that. And even if you’re helpless without me, it doesn’t change the fact that she doesn’t want me there.
: Nor am I all that excited to deal with the next girl I catch you having sex with, since Noriko surely won’t be the last.
: She’ll be the most painful, though. So at least we’ve gotten that out of the way.
: Hooraaaaay. Things can only go up from here...
: Just tell me what I can do. Really. What other movies do you like that I can embarrass myself by acting out in public?
: As much as I’d love to just give you a list of things you can do to make me okay with dating again, I can’t. I don’t know if I can get there, Akira. I...need more time. I need...something.
: I just don’t know what it is. Nor do I imagine you’d be able to give it to me when your actions always revolve around you instead of me.
: I know. And I’m not pretending they don’t. That’s why I said this is selfish. But maybe in taking advantage of your feelings for me again, you will think of something.
: It’s starting to sound like you’re trying to force me to be with you. Which is basically the opposite of our last conversation, so please forgive me if I’m not really getting it.
: I don’t know how much more simple I can make it than, “I love you. Please love me back.”
scene sayanything16
: I do. I hate it, but I do. Can anyone love someone so much that they can just overlook constant betrayal, though?
: If anyone can, it’s you.
: And that’s supposed to make me feel better? You’re not even pretending that you’re going to try and stop. You’re asking me to walk face-first into a life of permanent disloyalty.
: Why in a million fucking years would I ever do that, Akira? Especially when you’re expecting me to compete with my fucking sister of all people?
: I’m not asking you to compete with anyone. That’s not fair to them since you’d win every time.
scene sayanything17
: Stroke my ego as much as you want. It’s not going to bring us any closer to a reunion.
: It’s true, though. Like, I imagine that’s a bigger part of why Ami kept pushing you away than the whole issue with replacing her mom.
: Maybe. But I’m not even going to pretend to understand that girl anymore, so there’s no point in discussing her either.
: There’s no point in trying to understand her at all when you’d be better off just putting her in her place. That’s what I’ve been trying to pivot to lately.
: So what? You just need an extra babysitter? Is that it?
: No, I need a girl who can handle emotional manipulation and layer after layer of abuse that would make even the most sane of human beings crumble.
scene sayanything18
: Well, at least you’re being honest about it. So thanks for throwing my hat into the ring of fire, I guess.
: It’s not just your hat. It’s your entire body. But I’ll be right there with you and the two of us can go up in a blaze of glory together while gasoline rains down on us from clouds of malice.
: The tone of this conversation no longer fits Peter Gabriel. Why should we have to suffer like that when we could honestly just run away together and be happier that way?
: Because those clouds are following me. They have been since I was a kid. And if I’m ever going to be the man you want me to be, one who can actually make you happy, I need to be reborn in flames.
scene sayanything19
: I love you, Niki. Even when everything I do seems to prove the opposite. So please, witness my self-immolation and inevitably burn off your flesh while trying to extinguish me.
: This is the worst sales pitch I have ever heard. You’re very lucky I want to see you on fire right now or I would have already stopped listening.
: I’ll let you light the first match if it helps convince you to give me another shot.
: Are you going to keep cheating on me, Akira?
: No non-answers or trying to dodge the question. Just give me a yes or no. That’s it.
: Yes. I am.
: Mm.
: That’s what I thought.
: It’s not...how it sounds, though. And I know it sounds horrible, but I don’t think I’ll always be this way.
: And I’m supposed to just believe that? That you’ll just magically change for the better one day? Because that’s way too optimistic for even me.

: No, I just...there’s a catalyst somewhere out there. Something I don’t know yet, but...it’s something in the back of my mind. Constantly telling me that there’s a life after this where things are good.
: I can sense it somewhere in the depths of my dreams. I have...what feels like memories of it in the middle of the day.
: And yes, that may sound crazy, but there are a million other things I could tell you that would sound even crazier because this world is nothing but vibrantly colored madness.
: And you think it’s possible that, after all the suffering and everything else that happens, there’s a chance you and I could have a life of our own. Is that it?
: That’s it.
: And I’m supposed to buy into that and struggle now in hopes that you’re right?
: I’ll do my best to limit the struggling part, but yes. That’s it.
: Hm.
: Any questions?
: Many. But before I waste any more time asking them, I just want it to be known that I have put my faith in you so many times, Akira. And that I’ve been let down every single one of them.
: All I’ve ever had has been hope that things would be different someday. So there’s no point in trying to sell me that philosophy when it’s all I know in the first place.
: Well, what then? There has to be something I can do to get you back. Just name it.
: Don’t just look at me like that...It’s torture.
: Good. I hope this is what you see every time you close your eyes. Every time you share your “love” with someone else when it’s supposed to belong to me.
: It will one day. We just need to get out of here. And I need you to trust me.
: Well, I can tell you now that’s not going to happen.
scene sayanything20
: But...
: But?
: I suppose if I can make you suffer like I have...
: I might be willing to come live in your stupid house again.
: I left my favorite mug there, so...I’ve been meaning to go back anyway.
: Suffer...how, exactly? What do you want me to do? What will you do?
: I have a few ideas. All designed to make your life a living hell. And if you thought I was overbearing before, you haven’t seen anything yet.
: You’re a lot of things, but...I don’t think overbearing is one of them.
: Let’s see how long you believe that for when I’m making every single girl who so much as speaks to you understand that you are my property.
: Can I ask...how you intend to do that, exactly? Or is this just going to be a surprise?
scene sayanything21

: It’ll be a surprise. But I have other conditions too. And I expect you to serve me and fulfill every single desire I have from now until this future you claim we’ll have one day. Do I make myself clear?
: Type me up a list and I’ll frame it on every wall in my house so I’m forced to remember.
: You’d be better off tattooing it on your arm so you don’t conveniently forget the second you leave. Does that work for you?
: Sure. So long as the tattoo won’t bother you.
: You’re really serious then?
: Of course I’m serious.
: You really do want me back?
: I need you back. It’s not just “wanting.” I was a fool for ever thinking I could live without you. And I don’t want you to be sad on your own anymore.
: If you’re mad at me, I want to fight about it. If I upset you, I want to see the look on your face when you’re crying. If I’m disloyal, I want you to make me feel like shit.
: I want you to make me a better person, Niki. Even if it feels like it’s not worth the time or the effort, which we both know it’s probably not.
: Come here. And put the fucking boombox down.
: Am I...uhh...Is the part where I kiss your feet?
: Just fucking come over here, idiot.
scene sayanything22
: Okay, but...what’s going on exactly?

: I’ve had the same phone wallpaper for years now and I would like to finally change it if I’m going to be entering yet another miserable arc of my shitty relationship with my shitty childhood friend.
: We’re...back together then? The Say Anything worked?
: I don’t want to say we’re “back together.” Just that I enjoy how desperate you are now and that I’d like to see more of that.
: I’ll be staying at your place tonight. And I expect the lock on your door to be changed by the time I get there so I don’t have to worry about your twisted fucking daughter killing me in my sleep.
scene sayanything23
: I don’t know how to change a lock, but I can figure it out if it brings you home.
: Just shut the fuck up and look at the camera.
scene sayanything24
: Okay...but if you send this to Ami before I have a chance to warn her that her life is about to get harder again-
: Do you really think you’re in the position to be trying to talk me out of literally anything right now, Akira?
: You are nothing but a pathetic puppet who will dance on my strings and go along with everything I say for the rest of forever. Smile.
: Uhh...ch...cheese?
scene white
scene sayanything25
: Oh, Niki...You pathetic, lovesick moron.
: You have no clue what you just signed up for, do you?...
: It’s almost like you enjoy suffering.
: And yet...
scene black
scene sayanything26
: The suffering has only just begun...
scene black
